In the second leg of the Spring Senior 
Spring Triple Crown, and above all, a 
Tenno Sho (Spring) packed with mighty 
rivals, Marvelous Sunday couldn't contain 
her excitement.

Mayano Top Gun in pursuit of dazzling 
races, Sakura Laurel who stood back up no 
matter how many times injuries struck her 
down, and—

Narita Brian, who was once said to have 
"belonged to the past era," also overcame 
her injuries to stand on this grand stage.

The miracle of running in the very same 
race at this exact moment. The most 
marvelous showdown finally begins...!
